claims: FOMC voted 10-2 to maintain federal funds target range at 3.75%-4.00%
both dissenters preferred a 25bp rate increase
economic activity expanding at strong pace; inflation remains elevated; uncertainty elevated in part owing to geopolitical developments
limitations: policy statement does not forecast XRP or crypto prices
daily par yields are interpolated from indicative bid-side Treasury prices, not executed transactions

sources.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
limitations: overnight repo rate is not identical to Circle's realized reserve portfolio yield

analytical_implications: Circle says reserve income is linked to reserve returns near SOFR; high short-term rates support reserve income but create a macro-sensitive revenue channel.
Coinbase's Q3 filing says lower average interest rates reduced stablecoin revenue despite all-time-high average USDC balances.
A high-rate/higher-real-yield regime can raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding XRP; this is a competing causal hypothesis, not a directional forecast.

A lower-rate regime may reduce Circle/Coinbase stablecoin reserve income while easing financial conditions; the net effect on XRP is ambiguous and depends on liquidity, risk appetite, dollar strength and flows.
